topics.name: SQL
topics.description: Relational databases, queries and analytical thinking

entries.title: Understanding SQL joins
entries.summary: How INNER JOIN and LEFT JOIN combine records across related tables.
entries.body: INNER JOIN returns matching rows from both tables. LEFT JOIN keeps all rows from the left table, including unmatched rows.

entries.title: German word order
entries.summary: Main clauses generally place the conjugated verb second, while subordinate clauses move it to the end.
entries.body: Compare: Ich lerne Deutsch. Ich glaube, dass ich Deutsch lerne.
